posts.title: Sideways Elevation Contours
posts.description: A site-specific design for the Two Sigma London office, which visualizes the elevation contours of the neighborhood as though they were visible through the wall upon which the graphic is mounted. (The variation in terrain is, of course, exaggerated.)

posts.title: The Center of Europe
posts.description: There is no single way to compute the geographic center of a region. And there are many geographic centers of Europe because of this.[1]
